[[File:Bernard Cabane and Celie Fox Cabane.jpg|thumb|Bernard Cabane and Celie Fox Cabane]]

'''Bernard Cabane''' (born 12 October 1945) is a French mountaineer, scientist (physicist and chemist), director emeritus of the [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|French National Center for Scientific Research]] (CNRS) in [[ESPCI|ESPCI ParisTech]] where he worked with Nobel Laureate [[Pierre Gilles De Gennes]] and corresponding member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-C/bernard-cabane.html|title=Bernard Cabane {{!}} Liste des membres de l'Académie des sciences / C {{!}} Listes par ordre alphabétique {{!}} Listes des membres {{!}} Membres {{!}} Nous connaître|website=www.academie-sciences.fr|language=fr-fr|access-date=2018-09-16}}</ref>  He was awarded the Silver Medal of the French National Center for Scientific Research. Expert in colloidal and surface science, wine tannins, [[polymer]]s and [[surfactant]]s, and [[fluid dynamics]]. In mountaineering, he is known for making the 7th ascent of Mt [[Salcantay|Salcantay in Peru.]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://publications.americanalpineclub.org/articles/12197140801/South-America-Peru-Cordilleras-Vilcabamba-and-Urubamba-Chuyunco-and-Salcantay-Cordillera-Vilcabamba|title=South America, Peru, Cordilleras Vilcabamba and Urubamba, Chuyunco and Salcantay, Cordillera Vilcabamba - AAC Publications - Search The American Alpine Journal and Accidents|website=publications.americanalpineclub.org|language=en|access-date=2018-09-16}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.summitpost.org/nevado-salkantay/761942|title=Nevado Salkantay : Climbing, Hiking & Mountaineering : SummitPost|website=www.summitpost.org|language=en|access-date=2018-09-16}}</ref>
